properties.name: The Art Institute of Chicago
properties.description: One of the oldest and largest art museums in the United States, known for its Impressionist collection.

properties.name: Money Museum
properties.description: An interactive museum at the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago exploring currency and financial history.

properties.name: Field Museum of Natural History
properties.description: A world-renowned natural history museum home to Sue the T. rex and extensive anthropological collections.

properties.name: Dreihaus Gallery of Stained Glass
properties.description: A stunning collection of American and European stained glass art inside Navy Pier.

properties.name: Museum of Contemporary Art
properties.description: One of the nation’s largest contemporary art museums, featuring rotating exhibitions of modern works.

properties.name: Chicago History Museum
properties.description: A museum dedicated to Chicago's rich and complex history through artifacts, exhibitions, and storytelling.

properties.name: Chicago Cultural Center
properties.description: A landmark building offering free art exhibits and events, known for its stunning Tiffany glass dome.

properties.name: Chicago Architecture Center
properties.description: A hub for architectural exhibits and river tours showcasing Chicago’s iconic skyline and design legacy.
